description: Reporting documents suspension of CNL activities and arrests tied to alleged meetings, but reviewed bodies do not establish a qualifying public protest or gathering during the month. The June 11 bar episode is not coded as a protest; the separately alleged bistro meeting lacks an exact date and attendance.
required_followup: If a contemporaneous report of an actual public gathering appears, assess its date, simultaneous attendance and participants’ own demand; do not treat restrictions or arrests alone as protest evidence.

description: SOS Médias describes shop closures and policy complaints during collection of high-denomination banknotes, but does not establish that closures were an organized strike/protest. Its approximately 200 depositors are spread across three zones and are not protest attendance.
required_followup: Follow only if reporting establishes organized collective action and a simultaneous gathering or other qualifying event; do not aggregate depositors across zones.

description: Recorded English/French and Kirundi/French regional searches, CNL restriction and banknote-policy follow-up form a bounded open-web pass, not a census of all localities, sectors or archives.
required_followup: Pursue material newly identified local leads; absence in these results is not evidence of no nationwide protest activity.
